svg.desc: Implemented OpenStack path · Warpgate SSH gateway · OpenBao certificates · Temporary Neutron forwarding

text.tspan: Latch — Server access and network architecture
Implemented OpenStack path · Warpgate SSH gateway · OpenBao certificates · Temporary Neutron forwarding
Persist grant / cleanup state in SQLite.
Validate instance, project and port ownership.
Concurrent grants share one network path.
Remove it after the final grant closes.
CA private key stays in Bao.
OpenBao signs Warpgate’s target public key; Warpgate injects the short-lived ubuntu certificate.
User → Warpgate → routable floating IP → Neutron forwarding → tenant SSH. No full VM-port association.
Disconnecting leaves a grant active until revoke / expiry.
Latch removes admission and closes that grant’s SSH.
The final grant releases owned Neutron forwarding.
An API outage can delay active-session termination.
